subject: Post-call recap: Data retention exception request (FinEdge) - next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Chen <alice@finedge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Data retention exception request (FinEdge) - next steps

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the detailed walkthrough of FinEdge's onboarding flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Requirements you reiterated:
  - No persistent storage of customer PII in Redwood logs (0-retention for PII-derived tokens).
  - Short-term operational logs only (max 7 days) for debugging; masked/redacted before any longer-term storage.
  - Data residency in us-west region for EU-regulated customers is not required for FinEdge today (US deployment OK).
  - Need a written exception/contract clause and an internal SOC2/audit artifact showing controls.

- Next steps I propose:
  1) I'll loop in Legal & Security to review a formal Data Retention Exception (DRE) and proposed verbiage.
  2) Marissa (CC'ed) will provide a baseline exception template + our SOC2 summary.
  3) We schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to sign off on the clause and timeline (please share any procurement constraints).

Attachments: none in this message — I'll share the template once Legal adds comments.

If that looks good, would you be available Tue 5/4 or Wed 5/5 afternoon PT for the follow-up?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference
Office: +1 415-555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — production-grade inference with predictable economics

From: Alice Chen <alice@finedge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Data retention exception request (FinEdge) - next steps

Thanks Neha — that matches our notes. A couple clarifications: 

- The 0-retention requirement applies to any user-level identifiers or content that could be used to re-identify a user. We can accept short-lived operational traces for immediate debugging, but those must be purged within 48 hours for any PII-touching requests.
- We also need confirmation that any structured logs intended for billing/usage aggregation will be aggregated in an irreversible way (no raw PII fields).

Procurement wise, we are on a tight timeline — expecting a signed PO by 5/14. If we can get the DRE language in the contract and a SOC2 extract, that would unblock our legal.

Available Tue 5/4 2-4pm PT for a follow-up.

Best,
Alice
Legal & Ops, FinEdge
alice@finedge.com

- SOC2-Report-2026.pdf (stub) — redacted SOC2 summary and control descriptions about logging and retention.

High-level: 
- We can commit to a 48-hour purge window for traces that contain PII, subject to contractual DRE sign-off. Operational logs for platform health (non-PII) can be retained up to 7 days by default.
- For billing/usage aggregation, we will provide only aggregated, irreversible metrics (no raw PII fields). Our ingestion pipeline supports on-ingest hashing and field-stripping; Security has confirmed this is available for new tenants.
- Region: we will provision FinEdge in us-west as requested; data residency for audit artifacts can be provided via tenant-specific controls.

Alice — if the above maps to your needs I can have Legal insert the DRE verbiage into the SOW/Order Form and route for signature.
